user.title: Simple Timer Card
user.description: Keeps timers in Home Assistant, so they keep running and can run an action when they finish, even with no dashboard open.

data.capture_voice_commands: Show delayed voice commands as timers
data.late_action_minutes: Run late actions for up to (minutes)

data_description.capture_voice_commands: Commands like "turn off the lights in 10 minutes" appear on the card and can be paused or cancelled.
data_description.late_action_minutes: If a timer ended while Home Assistant was stopped, its action still runs at startup when it is no later than this. 0 skips late actions.

create_timer.name: Create timer
create_timer.description: Starts a timer that can run a command or actions when it ends.

command.name: Command
command.description: What to say to Home Assistant when the timer ends, for example "turn off the air purifier".

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Actions to run when the timer ends.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the command. Defaults to the Home Assistant language.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.description: Extra data stored with the timer, such as card options.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timer
cancel_timer.description: Stops a timer without running its action.

finish_timer.name: Finish timer
finish_timer.description: Ends a timer now and runs its action.

remove_timer.name: Remove timer
remove_timer.description: Removes a timer from the list.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How much time to add or subtract.

subtract_time.name: Subtract time
subtract_time.description: Removes time from a timer. Removing more than is left finishes it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How much time to add or subtract.

restart_timer.name: Restart timer
restart_timer.description: Runs a timer again, keeping its name and action.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: New length. Defaults to the original duration.

get_timers.name: Get timers
get_timers.description: Returns the timers in the list.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only return timers with these statuses.
